documentation.content:
An execution of the Cloud Run job **valuation-update** failed. A failure means a crash, a version conflict when uploading the database, or data that is stale (see the `STALE` lines in the job log). The data that could be saved was saved first.

What to do: open the failed execution (Cloud Run > Jobs > valuation-update > Executions > Logs) and see docs/operations.md in the repository.
